ports.label: LAN
ports.notes: 10/100/1000 Base-T host control / configuration.

ports.label: Dante 1
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (2-port internal switch).

ports.label: Dante 2
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (2-port internal switch).

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 host control on a 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw (38400 baud default). (3-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Digital I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on a 3-pole captive screw (In/GND/Out per channel).

ports.label: Digital I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on a 3-pole captive screw (In/GND/Out per channel).

ports.label: ACP Bus
ports.notes: ACP audio control panel bus on a 4-pole 3.5mm captive screw — supports up to 8 ACP panels (+12V/+S/-S/G). Mapped to `serial` SignalType (no `acp`/`ebus` type in src/types.ts). (4-pole captive screw)

ports.label: EXP
ports.notes: Proprietary 16×16 bidirectional digital audio expansion port over shielded CAT6 (24-bit / 48 kHz uncompressed). Used to link two DMP units or link to a DTP CrossPoint matrix. Mapped to `aes` SignalType per session 5 XMP 240 convention (no `extron-exp` SignalType in src/types.ts).

ports.label: USB Audio
ports.notes: Rear-panel USB Mini-B for USB audio bridge (USB 2.0 high-speed). Up to 4 channels of digital audio in/out.

ports.label: USB Config (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for DSP Configurator / PCS configuration (USB 2.0).

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: External 12VDC PSU brick (100-240 VAC input).
